title: Cinematic Hero
description: A sculptural editorial hero with sequenced type, pointer-responsive depth, and a warm celestial composition.
installation: Copy component.tsx and useReducedMotion.ts into your project, then import styles.css once. React 18 or 19 is required.
reducedMotion: The pointer response is disabled and entrance transitions are reduced to an effectively static state when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
